prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless tileable emission-nebula texture for an Unreal Engine 5.8 background material and future volumetric-density source
Primary request: Create one square deep-space emission nebula texture: soft, layered, billowing interstellar gas with a restrained magenta and violet core palette transitioning through muted indigo into teal and cyan along cloud edges, set against near-black space. Add only a few slender brighter emission filaments and sparse tiny pinprick stars.
Style/medium: cinematic Hubble-like astrophotography, inspired by the physical color relationships and fine gaseous detail of Pillars of Creation and the Carina Nebula, but fully abstract, non-iconic, and without a recognizable hero formation
Composition/framing: orthographic texture field with truly uniform 360-degree continuity; evenly distribute cloud density, detail, color energy, and local contrast across the full frame; every edge must wrap exactly to its opposite edge; no central subject, no dominant diagonal, no compositional border, no large empty quadrant, no isolated hotspot
Lighting/mood: deep, immersive, filmic, restrained highlights, rich shadow separation without crushed featureless regions
Color palette: near-black blue-black space; dusty magenta and violet interior gas; desaturated teal/cyan rims; natural astrophotographic color grading, never fluorescent
Materials/textures: multiscale wispy vapor, translucent overlapping cloud strata, subtle particulate dust, a few fine filament strands, sparse subpixel-scale stars
Constraints: seamless/tileable periodic texture on both X and Y axes; opposite edges must match in structure, luminance, and color; suitable for a visibly repeated 2×2 test; even local contrast across all quadrants; RGB image; no alpha; no text; no watermark
Avoid: obvious seam, edge darkening, vignette, center glow, single blown-out blob, hero pillar, recognizable object, planet, galaxy disk, large stars, starburst, lens flare, neon saturation, hard posterization, black empty corners, noisy uniform starfield, borders
